type.description: Visual variant: flat (icon only), normal (default, bordered with the counter) or enhanced (filled in the severity colour). Available when globalCounter==false.

alertType.description: The alert type that selects the icon and colours. The Cadre priorities map onto it as wiki 13 section 11.1 says: Critical level-critical, High alarm, Medium warning, Low caution, Diagnostic empty (no alert colour); level-high, level-medium and level-low draw the same colours as alarm, warning and caution. Empty draws the idle state.

nAlerts.description: Number of active alerts; 0 shows the idle bell and hides the counter.

counter.description: Shows nAlerts next to the bell (not in flat). Available when globalCounter==false.

globalCounter.description: Shows the per-severity counts, the bell and the total instead of a single alert status.

shelvedCount.description: Number of shelved alerts, shown after the global counter badges. Available when globalCounter==true.

blinking.description: Flashes the bell while there are active alerts of a flashing alert type. Available when globalCounter==false.

flashingSpeed.description: Flash tempo while blinking is on: default resolves from alertType, fast, slow, very-slow force a tempo, fixed never flashes. Available when blinking==true.

fillHeight.description: Stretches the visible button to the host height instead of the 32 px visual target.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name forwarded to the inner <button>, mapped to the aria-label attribute; replaces the generated label. aria-labelledby is not supported: ID references cannot cross the shadow boundary.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
